name: Beast ~Injuu no Yakata~
source:
The main figure of the game is Muneto. He and his 4 friends are caught in a rain under a forest exploration. Timely they see a light from a house. It's a mansion of question. They come to it and beg allowance of their stayover. A servant Sandaihu rejects it but fortunately and kindly the mistress Kiriko accepts it. Thus Muneto and his friends have entered the land of beast.
They sleep in each room. Muneto spends night playing H with his beloved Kotone and later Kiriko. Now, as Muneto wakes up in next morning, people have disappeared except Sandaihu. What's going on? From now on you must clear the game to save friends.

[From [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=36&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
遊戲主角是宗人。他與四名朋友在森林探險時遇上大雨，恰好看見一棟房屋亮著燈。那是一座充滿謎團的宅邸，眾人前去請求借宿。僕人三太夫拒絕了他們，幸好女主人霧子心地善良，答應讓他們留下。就這樣，宗人和朋友們踏入了野獸的領地。
眾人分別在各自的房間入睡。宗人與心愛的琴音歡愛，後來又與霧子發生關係。第二天早晨醒來後，他卻發現除三太夫外，其他人全都消失了。究竟發生了什麼？從現在起，你必須把遊戲破關，救出朋友。
